title: A1 · Beginner
description: Introduce yourself, talk about everyday life, family, home, food and plans.

objectives.can_do: I can introduce myself and give basic personal information.
objectives.title: Presentarme

activities.instruction: Introduce yourself to the tutor: your name, country, city and job.
activities.target: I am ... / My name is ... / I live in ...

objectives.can_do: I can ask someone's name and where they are from.
objectives.title: Preguntar el nombre y origen

activities.instruction: Ask the tutor three personal questions using What / Where.
activities.target: What is your name? / Where are you from?

checks.prompt: Which question word do you use for a place?

objectives.can_do: I can say my country and nationality.
objectives.title: Países y nacionalidades

activities.instruction: Complete: 'I am ___ Spain. I am ___.'
activities.target: I am from Spain. I am Spanish.

objectives.can_do: I can say and understand numbers from 1 to 100.
objectives.title: Números 1-100

activities.instruction: Listen to the tutor and write down the number you hear.
activities.target: recognize numbers 1-100

objectives.can_do: I can describe my daily routine.
objectives.title: Mi rutina diaria

activities.instruction: Describe a typical day to the tutor using the Present Simple.
activities.target: I get up at ... / I go to ... / I have breakfast at ...

objectives.can_do: I can tell the time and talk about days and months.
objectives.title: La hora, días y meses

activities.instruction: Say what time you do two activities and on which day.
activities.target: I ... at ... on Monday.

checks.prompt: Which word is a day of the week?
Listen: 'quarter past eight'. What time is it?
Listen: 'It's half past three.' What time is it?

objectives.can_do: I can talk about how often I do things.
objectives.title: Frecuencia

activities.instruction: Tell the tutor how often you do three activities.
activities.target: I always ... / I sometimes ... / I never ...

objectives.can_do: I can talk about my family.
objectives.title: Mi familia

activities.instruction: Describe your family to the tutor using 'I have got'.
activities.target: I have got a brother. / My mother is ...

checks.prompt: Which word is a family member?

objectives.can_do: I can describe people's appearance and personality.
objectives.title: Describir personas

activities.instruction: Describe a friend using three adjectives.
activities.target: He/She is tall and friendly.

objectives.can_do: I can talk about what belongs to people.
objectives.title: Posesivos

activities.instruction: Complete: 'This is Maria and ___ brother.'
activities.target: This is Maria and her brother.

checks.prompt: Choose the correct word: 'This is Maria and ___ brother.'
Choose the correct word: '___ name is John.' (él)

objectives.can_do: I can describe my home and the rooms in it.
objectives.title: Mi casa

activities.instruction: Describe your home using 'There is / There are'.
activities.target: There is a kitchen. / There are two bedrooms.

checks.prompt: Which word is a room of the house?

objectives.can_do: I can say where things are using prepositions.
objectives.title: Preposiciones de lugar

activities.instruction: Listen and say where the object is.
activities.target: The book is on the table.

checks.prompt: Choose the correct word: 'The book is ___ the table.' (sobre la mesa)
Listen: 'The keys are under the chair.' Where are the keys?

objectives.can_do: I can talk about food and drinks.
objectives.title: Comida y bebida

activities.instruction: Say what food and drink you like and don't like.
activities.target: I like ... / I don't like ...

objectives.can_do: I can order food in a restaurant or cafe.
objectives.title: Pedir comida

activities.instruction: Order a drink and a dish from the tutor.
activities.target: Can I have a coffee and some bread, please?

options: Can I have a coffee please yes?

objectives.can_do: I can ask about prices and buy things.
objectives.title: Precios

activities.instruction: Ask the tutor the price of two items.
activities.target: How much is this?

checks.prompt: Choose the correct word: 'How much are ___ shoes?' (plural)

objectives.can_do: I can talk about clothes.
objectives.title: La ropa

activities.instruction: Compare two items: 'This shirt is ___ than that one.'
activities.target: This shirt is cheaper than that one.

checks.prompt: Which word is an item of clothing?

options: This shirt is cheaper than that one.
This shirt is cheap than that one.
This shirt more cheap than that one.

objectives.can_do: I can talk about places in a town.
objectives.title: Lugares de la ciudad

activities.instruction: Name three places near your home.
activities.target: There is a supermarket near my home.

checks.prompt: Which word is a place in town?
Listen: 'There is a supermarket near my home.' What is near his home?
Listen: 'The hospital is next to the park.' Where is the hospital?

objectives.can_do: I can ask for and give simple directions.
objectives.title: Pedir indicaciones

activities.instruction: Ask the tutor how to get to the station and follow their directions.
activities.target: How do I get to the station? / Turn left ...

checks.prompt: Choose the correct word: '___ left at the corner.'
Listen: 'Turn right at the bank.' What do you do at the bank?
Listen: 'The station is opposite the park.' Where is the station?

objectives.can_do: I can talk about where I was and what I did yesterday.
objectives.title: El pasado (was/were)

activities.instruction: Tell the tutor where you were yesterday.
activities.target: I was at home yesterday.

options: They are at the park last week.

objectives.can_do: I can say what I did in the past.
objectives.title: Past Simple (verbos regulares)

activities.instruction: Say three things you did last week.
activities.target: I played ... / I visited ...

checks.prompt: Which word is the past of 'work'?

objectives.can_do: I can talk about my future plans.
objectives.title: Planes futuros

activities.instruction: Tell the tutor two things you are going to do next week.
activities.target: I am going to ... next week.

options: I am going to travel next week.
I going to travel next week.

objectives.can_do: I can make and respond to invitations.
objectives.title: Invitar

activities.instruction: Invite the tutor to do something and accept an invitation.
activities.target: Would you like to go to the cinema?

options: Would you like to go to the cinema?
Do you would like to go to the cinema?
Would you like go to the cinema?

objectives.can_do: I can hold a short basic conversation about myself, my life and my plans.
objectives.title: Conversación final A1
concepts: review: introductions, routines, family, past, plans

activities.instruction: Have a short conversation with the tutor covering introductions, your routine and your plans.
activities.target: A1 level conversation

options: I am from Spain and I live in Madrid.
I from Spain and I live in Madrid.
I am from Spain and I lives in Madrid.
I was at school yesterday and I played football.
I was at school yesterday and I play football.
I am at school yesterday and I played football.

checks.prompt: Listen: 'I get up at seven and I go to work at eight.' What time does he go to work?
Listen: 'My name is Ana. I am from Spain.' Where is Ana from?
